pie: ph₂ter nos mógʰus súHm̥ stéh₂yet. h₁yós stéh₂yeti só dusménēs. h₁ím kʷis widét? deywṓs h₁ím widónt gʰrémonti-kʷe. súHnew mē stéh₂yes. ne stéh₂yōh₂.
english: Father, a boy stole our pig. Whoever steals, he is ill-minded. Did anyone see him? The gods saw him, and they are angry. Do not steal, son! I shall not steal.

pie: kʷíh₁ bʰréh₂ter snéh₂si? wédni h₁épi l̥gʰdʰí gʰébʰestih₁-kʷe toy Hyowdʰéye. dedwóyh₂e. mē tréses tetólh₂h₂e te. spéḱye snéh₂mi. moḱs h₁éwks.
english: Brother, how do you swim? Lie down on the water, and move your arms. I am afraid. Do not tremble: I am holding you up. Look: I am swimming! You have learned quickly!

pie: kʷíd ph₂ter péh₂wr̥? h₁n̥gʷnís deywós. démi nos tḱéyti nékʷti-kʷe nos gʷʰr̥néwti. kʷíd moy gʰébʰestim h₁éwset? h₁íd h₁éps. súHnew péh₂wr̥ mē h₁éps. h₁íd ne h₁époh₂.
english: Father, what is fire? Fire is a god. He dwells in our house, and at night he warms us. Why did he burn my hand? You grasped it. Do not grasp fire, son! I shall not grasp it.

pie: kʷíd h₂éǵroy dʰédʰeh₁si? h₂éǵrom h₂érh₃yoh₂. kʷíd h₂érh₃yesi? dʰéǵʰōm dʰéwgʰesi h₁édomes-kʷe. ḱóm h₂érh₃yōmes. súHnew túH h₂yéwHō. h₁yód h₂wéksesi h₂érh₃yēsi.
english: What are you doing in the field? I am ploughing the field. Why are you ploughing? The earth will be productive, and we shall eat. Let us plough together! Son, you are young. When you have grown up, you will plough.

pie: owis eḱwobʰyos eweket, "ḱerd angʰetai moi widontei ǵʰm̥onm̥ eḱwons aǵontm̥."
english: The sheep said to the horses: "My heart pains me, seeing a man driving horses."

pie: gʷm̥sḱéti kʷis. kʷíh₁ h₁ésmey bʰéh₂oh₂? h₁ésmey wr̥h₁dʰí. príHe gʰóstey gʷm̥dʰí. príHe gʰóstey gʷm̥dʰí. nu h₁ésmey wódr̥ dh₃dʰí h₁ím-kʷe ph₂wéni h₁épi sodéye. nu kʷíd wéwkōh₂? wéwke. n̥sméy priHós h₁sdʰí.
english: Someone is coming. How shall I speak to him? Say to him: Come, dear guest! Come, dear guest! Then give him water, and seat him by the fire. What shall I say then? Say: Be dear to us!

pie: h₁yód ǵérh₂ont túH h₂yuHn̥ḱós h₁és kʷíd dʰédʰeh₁s? ḱóymosyo h₂ówins péh₂sm̥. nu wĺ̥kʷos gʷémt h₁ím-kʷe soksṓys h₂epó ǵʰḗm. bʰéyh₂s? ne bʰéyh₂m̥ h₂yuHn̥ḱós HeHḱús-kʷe h₁ésm̥.
english: Elder, when you were young, what did you do? I used to guard the sheep of the household. A wolf came, and I drove it away with stones. Did you become afraid? I did not become afraid: I was young and swift!

pie: h₁yód ǵérh₂onts h₁ludʰét kʷíd stéh₂s? só pl̥h₁éwih₂n̥s ǵʰéyomn̥s dedórḱe. polh₁úh₂ wóyde h₁ím-kʷe gʷr̥nHmés. nu stéh₂oh₂. mógʰew kéh₂ileh₂bʰos h₁syéh₁s.
english: When the old man arrived, why did you stand up? He has seen many winters. He knows many things, and we praise him. Then I shall stand up. May you be well, boy.

pie: gʰóstis moy déh₃nom déh₃t. kʷíh₁ h₁ésmey bʰéh₂oh₂? h₁ésmey wéwke. túH h₁uséwōm déh₃tōr. túH h₁uséwōm déh₃tōr. nu h₁éy méwdeti h₁ésmey-kʷe priHós h₁ésesi.
english: The guest gave me a gift. How shall I speak to him? Say to him: You are a giver of good things. You are a giver of good things! Now he will be glad, and you will be dear to him.

pie: kʷís méh₂ter dyḗws? dyḗws méǵh₂s h₃rḗǵs. dyḗws ph₂tḗr n̥smé dedórḱe. dedórḱe me? dedórḱe te. mē kʷim dʰrugʰyés. ne kʷim dʰrugʰyṓh₂. nu te dʰúgh₂ter h₁éy ph₂syéh₁t.
english: Mother, who is Dyeus? Dyeus is the great king. Father Sky sees us. Does he see me? He sees you. Deceive no one! I shall deceive no one. Then may he protect you, daughter.

pie: h₂ówis tu h₁eḱwoibʰ(y)os weukʷét, "ḱḗr Hegʰnutór moi h₁éḱwons Héǵontm̥ Hnérm̥ widn̥tbʰ(y)os."
english: The sheep said to the horses: "My heart pains me, seeing a man driving horses."

pie: kʷíh₁ méh₂trey mléwHoh₂? kénkoh₂. h₁ésyeh₂ey skʷdʰí. méh₂ter kénkoh₂. nu toy kʷid h₁íh₂ déh₃eti. bʰréh₂ter túH kénkesi? ne kénkoh₂ h₂éḱh₃m̥.
english: How shall I speak to mother? I am hungry. Say to her: Mother, I am hungry. Then she will give you something. You, brother, are you hungry? I am not hungry; I have eaten.

pie: kʷíd h₃réǵ bʰoydʰéh₂h₁? bʰoydʰéh₂ wékʷos h₂nḗr diwéy h₁yód dédeh₃ti. h₁yós swéh₂m bʰoydʰéh₂m Hrunépti deywṓs tósmey gʰrémonti. wékʷos moy ne Hrunépoh₂. népot tód memn̥dʰí.
english: King, what is an oath? An oath is a word which a man gives to Dyeus. Whoever breaks his oath, the gods are angry at him. I shall not break my word. Remember that, grandson.

pie: kʷíd póh₂imen h₁énod dʰewsóm? mógʰew h₁énos wĺ̥kʷoh₁. h₁éy ḱwṓ? h₁éy ne ḱwṓ. ḱwónes ḱóymom ph₂sénti wĺ̥kʷōs h₂ówins gʷʰnénti. tóm dedwóyh₂e. mē tréses h₂léksoh₂ te.
english: Shepherd, what animal is that yonder? That is a wolf, boy. Is it a dog? It is not a dog. Dogs guard the household; wolves kill the sheep. I am afraid of that one. Do not tremble: I protect you.

pie: woséye me stéwdt. déywoǵenh₁es woséyeso. nu túH méǵh₂ih₂. h₂wĺ̥h₁neh₂ me gʷʰr̥néwti. spéḱye woséyoh₂e. gʷr̥néHmi te.
english: Dress me: it has turned cold! Dress yourself, Of-Divine-Race! You are big now. The wool warms me. Look: I have dressed myself! I praise you.

pie: bʰréh₂ter gʰóstis gʷegʷóme. kʷíd h₁ím ph₂wéni h₁épi sodéyomes? h₁yós gʰóstim h₂epó h₂éǵeti tósyo ḱléwos néḱt. nu h₁ésmey wódr̥ déh₃oh₂. tód dʰh₁dʰí dṓm-kʷe nos gʷr̥néHeti.
english: Brother, a stranger has come. Why do we seat him by the fire? Whoever drives a guest away, his fame vanishes. Then I shall give him water. Do that, and he will praise our house.

pie: kʷíh₁ ǵénh₁tri gʷṓm h₂mélǵoh₂? ḱóm sddʰí. h₁ím mē Hyowdʰéyes. h₁ím gʰbʰestíbʰis h₂ml̥ǵdʰí. spéḱye. h₂mélǵmi. moḱs h₁éwks. h₁éy-ge méwdt.
english: Mother, how shall I milk the cow? Sit down close by. Do not agitate it. Milk it with both hands. Look! I am milking! You have learned quickly. It has indeed become glad.

pie: kúdʰe ph₂ter gʷṓs h₂éǵesi? súHnew h₁íns h₂éǵrom h₂éǵoh₂. h₂én h₁édn̥ti wódr̥-kʷe píph₃onti. h₁íns h₂éǵōh₂. ḱód ḱéntrom kapyé h₁íns-kʷe sékʷeso. h₁íns mē stunéds. h₁íns ne stunédoh₂ h₁íns wédʰōh₂.
english: Father, where are you driving the cattle? I am driving them to the pasture, son. There they eat and drink water. Let me drive them! Hold this goad and follow them. Do not beat them! I shall not beat them; I shall lead them.

pie: kʷíd ḱósyo h₁nómn̥? séh₂ toy gʰbʰestéyey. kʷíd ḱód? só toy h₂erHmós. kʷíd ḱód? h₂yúHn̥ḱe toy só ǵʰédos. gʰébʰestis h₂erHmós ǵʰédos-kʷe. tríh₂ wékʷesh₂ h₁éwks.
english: What is the name of this? That is your hand. What is this? That is your shoulder. What is this? That is your butt, young one! Hand, shoulder and butt! You have learned three words.

pie: kúdʰe ǵérh₂onts h₁ésti? h₁ím ne dedórḱh₂e. dʰúgh₂ter h₁éy mr̥tó. ph₂térn̥s gʷéh₂t. gʷémeti? ne gʷémeti h₁ím-kʷe memn̥mé. h₁ésyo ḱléwos ń̥dʰgʷʰitom.
english: Where is the old man? I do not see him. He has died, daughter. He has gone to the fathers. Will he come? He will not come, and we remember him. His fame is imperishable.

pie: kʷíd ḱós swónh₂os nékʷti? ḱwónes HrudHénti wĺ̥kʷom widónt. h₁éy dṓm wéyḱeti? ne wéyḱeti. ḱwónes h₂néres-kʷe n̥smé h₂léksonti. h₁súh₁eḱwa l̥gʰdʰí swopéyōh₂-kʷe te.
english: What is this sound in the night? The dogs are crying out; they have seen a wolf. Will he enter the house? He will not enter. The dogs and the men protect us. Lie down, Of-Good-Horses, and I shall put you to sleep.

pie: kʷíd moy méh₂ter ḱwṓ gʰébʰestim léyǵʰti? dʰúgh₂ter te stérgeti. h₁éy nos priHós. kʷíd h₁ésyo h₁nómn̥? h₁ésmey ḱlutóm h₁nómn̥ dʰh₁dʰí twé-kʷe gʷm̥yḗti.
english: Mother, why does the dog lick my hand? He loves you, daughter. He is our friend. What is his name? Set him a famous name, and he will come to you.

pie: swésor h₃rḗǵs gʷm̥sḱéti. kʷíd h₁ésmey sokʷéyōh₂? sokʷéye. h₃réǵ kéh₂ilos h₁sdʰí. h₃réǵ kéh₂ilos h₁sdʰí. nu sékʷeti. mógʰew kéh₂ilos h₁sdʰí.
english: Sister, the king is coming. What shall I say to him? Say: King, be well! King, be well! And he will say: Boy, be well!

pie: bʰréh₂ter kʷóterom h₁éḱwom yéwgoh₂? sénom yugdʰí. h₂yéwHō dedwóye. kʷíd dedwóye? yugóm ne wóyde. h₁ím yugóm wédʰe h₁éwketi-kʷe.
english: Brother, which of the two horses shall I yoke? Yoke the old one. The young one is afraid. Why is he afraid? He does not know the yoke. Lead him to the yoke, and he will learn.

pie: kʷéh₂ wékʷesh₂ swésor deywóybʰos wérh₁yomes? wérh₁yomes. déywōs nos h₁wésuh₂ dh₃té. dédh₃n̥ti? dédh₃n̥ti h₁yód h₁íns gʷr̥nHmés. déywōs nos h₁wésuh₂ dh₃té. nu te ḱluwént.
english: Sister, what words do we say to the gods? We say: Gods, give us good things! Do they give? They give, if we praise them. Gods, give us good things! Now they have heard you.

pie: kʷíd ǵénh₁tri pékʷesi? súHm̥ pékʷoh₂. kʷís h₁ím moréyet? bʰréh₂tēr toy h₁ím dʰǵʰyés moréyet. h₁ím ḱósyeh₂i nékʷti gʰostíbʰis ḱóm h₁édomes. kʷóm h₁éy pékʷētor? h₁yód h₁regʷesyéti.
english: Mother, what are you cooking? I am cooking a pig. Who killed it? Your brother killed it yesterday. This night we shall eat it with the guests. When will it be cooked? When it is getting dark.

pie: deywós wérunos diwés km̥tá gʷah₂t.
english: The god Werunos came down from heaven.

pie: kúdʰe ǵn̥h₁yóh₂e? ḱósmi démi ǵʰiméni ǵn̥h₁yéth₂e. ph₂tḗr toy twé tl̥néh₂t h₁nómn̥-kʷe toy dʰéh₁t. kʷód h₁nómn̥ dʰéh₁t? túH h₁suḱléwēs. ḱléwos toy méǵh₂ h₁syéh₁t.
english: Where was I born? You were born in this house, in winter. Your father lifted you up and set a name on you. What name did he set? You are Of-Good-Fame. May your fame be great.
